product.name: Financial Data Integration
product.description: Automatically collects and organizes financial data from tax authorities, banks, and company software to provide accurate and up-to-date financial information.

product.name: Bank Reconciliation
product.description: Automates the matching of bank transactions with company records using customizable rules and supports payment gateway reconciliations.

product.name: Accounts Receivable Management (Cobranza)
product.description: Manages customer collections by marking invoices as paid, sending collection emails, and tracking outstanding payments.

product.name: Financial Reporting and Dashboards
product.description: Generates customizable financial reports and dashboards including income statements, cash flow projections, and operational results.

identifier.value: Chart of Accounts Management (Plan de Cuentas)

product.name: Chart of Accounts Management (Plan de Cuentas)
product.description: Allows businesses to create and manage a structured chart of accounts to organize financial transactions and reporting.

product.name: Payment Gateway Reconciliation
product.description: Supports reconciliation of transactions from payment gateways like Transbank, GetNet, and Mercado Pago within the bank reconciliation process.
